notes: Fenrir Link puts your server on your phone: scan the code in the Fenrir Link card on the Dashboard. Friends scan theirs in Fenrir Connect.
Fenrir Setup no longer freezes on a new PC, and says plainly what went wrong if a step fails.
Friends keep their own mods and game settings, and an unfinished file list can never empty an installed pack.
Backups of Paper worlds include the Nether and the End, a failed backup waits before it tries again, and only one copy of the server can start.
Saved settings stay saved, Server settings keeps your edits until you press Save, and every page follows a world switch.
Harder to fool: look-alike web pages, hostile pack zips and guessed keys get nowhere.
